title: What Sparked the Oklahoma City Bombing?

scenes.text: 1995, a truck packed with 4,800 lbs of explosives detonates.
The blast killed 168 people, the deadliest domestic incident then.
The Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building before the attack.
Terrorists claimed it was retaliation against government overreach.
scenes.label: Retaliation Claim
scenes.sub: Militants said the bombing was a response to federal actions.
